Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Gale Gordon is credited on 373 distinct recordings across 12 programs from 1933-12-20 through 1953-06-14. Documented roles include performer on 352 recordings, narrator on 18 recordings, host on 16 recordings, and announcer on 3 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Fibber McGee and Molly (performer on 142 recordings; 142 distinct recordings), Fu Manchu (performer on 64 recordings and announcer on 3 recordings; 66 distinct recordings), My Favorite Husband (performer on 41 recordings; 41 distinct recordings), The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show (performer on 37 recordings; 37 distinct recordings), The Great Gildersleeve (performer on 33 recordings; 33 distinct recordings), Calling All Cars (narrator on 17 recordings, host on 16 recordings, and performer on 3 recordings; 21 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 16 recordings and narrator on 1 recording; 17 distinct recordings), and Dr. Christian (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Dr. James Petrie (64 portrayals), Rudolph Atterbury (41 portrayals), Mayor LaTrivia (7 portrayals), and Dr. William Todhunter Hall (1 portrayals).
